patch_description: The current best version already uses global replication (which lifted GPU balancedness to 0.76), but its Python-per-layer greedy packing loop is the main time cost, and its packing quality is capped by plain LPT. My design keeps global replication but replaces the hierarchical machinery with two novel components: (1) a fully batched LPT packer — a single Python loop over sorted item positions, but every operation is a vectorized tensor op across all layers at once, using masked argmin to respect per-GPU slot capacity; (2) a vectorized max/min-pack swap refinement pass that repeatedly moves the heaviest item from the most-loaded GPU to the least-loaded GPU (guaranteed strict decrease of max GPU load), which pushes balance beyond what one-shot greedy can achieve. Rank-in-pack is recomputed in one vectorized sort after refinement. This draws on the snake-packing program's insight (vectorization for speed) and the greedy program's insight (quality), combining them with a novel refinement loop that neither had.
